name: Hemlock
body:
Price 2,500 gp

DETAILS

Type poison (ingested); Save Fortitude DC 18; Onset 10 minutes; Frequency 1/minute for 6 minutes; Cure 2 consecutive saves

EFFECT

1d6 Dex damage, creatures reduced to 0 Dexterity suffocate
